## Identity, organization and policy

Who exists, which organization they belong to, how they sign in, and the organization's rules.

```mermaid
erDiagram
    Organization {
        uuid id PK
        datetime created_at
        datetime updated_at
        string name
        string slug UK
        string status
    }
    User {
        string password
        datetime last_login
        uuid id PK
        datetime created_at
        datetime updated_at
        uuid organization FK
        string email UK
        string full_name
        string role
        string status
        uuid department FK
    }
    Invitation {
        uuid id PK
        datetime created_at
        datetime updated_at
        uuid organization FK
        uuid user FK
        uuid invited_by FK
        string token_hash UK
        datetime expires_at
        datetime accepted_at
        datetime revoked_at
    }
    UserSession {
        string session_key PK
        uuid user FK
        uuid device FK
        datetime created_at
        ip ip_address
        string user_agent
    }
    TOTPDevice {
        int id PK
        uuid user FK, UK
        string secret_encrypted
        datetime confirmed_at
        int last_used_step
        datetime created_at
    }
    RecoveryCode {
        int id PK
        uuid user FK
        string code_hash
        datetime used_at
        datetime created_at
    }
    PasswordResetToken {
        uuid id PK
        datetime created_at
        datetime updated_at
        uuid user FK
        uuid issued_by FK
        string token_hash UK
        datetime expires_at
        datetime used_at
    }
    Department {
        uuid id PK
        datetime created_at
        datetime updated_at
        uuid organization FK
        string name
        string code
        uuid head FK
        string status
    }
    SecurityPolicy {
        uuid id PK
        datetime created_at
        datetime updated_at
        uuid organization FK, UK
        string name
        int min_password_length
        bool require_uppercase
        bool require_numbers
        bool require_symbols
        int max_password_age_days
        int expiry_warning_days
        bool allow_view_once
        int max_share_duration_days
        bool require_device_trust
        bool require_mfa
        bool block_on_high_risk
    }
    ServiceCatalog {
        uuid id PK
        datetime created_at
        datetime updated_at
        uuid organization FK
        string name
        string category
        string base_url
        string icon_url
        int default_port
        string status
    }
    Department |o--o{ User : "department"
    Device |o--o{ UserSession : "device"
    Organization ||--o{ Department : "organization"
    Organization ||--o{ Invitation : "organization"
    Organization ||--o{ ServiceCatalog : "organization"
    Organization ||--o{ User : "organization"
    Organization ||--o| SecurityPolicy : "organization"
    User |o--o{ Department : "head"
    User |o--o{ Invitation : "invited_by"
    User |o--o{ PasswordResetToken : "issued_by"
    User ||--o{ Invitation : "user"
    User ||--o{ PasswordResetToken : "user"
    User ||--o{ RecoveryCode : "user"
    User ||--o{ UserSession : "user"
    User ||--o| TOTPDevice : "user"
```

## Vault, sharing and access requests

Encrypted items, the keys that protect them, delegated access and the requests that lead to it.

```mermaid
erDiagram

        uuid id PK
        datetime created_at
        datetime updated_at
        uuid organization FK
        int version
        string wrapped_key
        int kek_version
        string status
        datetime retired_at
    }
    Credential {

        datetime updated_at
        uuid organization FK

        date expires_at
```

## Devices, anomalies, lockdown and notifications

Zero-trust signals and controls.

```mermaid
erDiagram
    Device {
        uuid id PK
        datetime created_at
        datetime updated_at
        uuid organization FK
        uuid user FK
        string name
        string token_hash UK
        string fingerprint_hash
        string os
        string browser
        string user_agent
        string trust_state

        ip last_ip
        datetime last_seen_at

    }
    DeviceEvent {
        int id PK
        uuid device FK

        ip ip_address

    }

        uuid target_user FK
        string reason

        bool is_active

    Notification {
        uuid id PK

        datetime read_at
```

## Audit and imports

The tamper-evident trail and bulk onboarding.

```mermaid
erDiagram
    AuditChainHead {
        string chain_key PK
        int last_sequence
        string last_hash
    }
    AuditLog {
        int id PK
        string chain_key
        int sequence
        string prev_hash
        string hash UK
        datetime created_at
        uuid organization FK
        uuid actor_id
        string actor_email
        string action
        string outcome
        string target_type
        string target_id
        string target_label
        string reason
        json metadata
        ip ip_address
        string user_agent
        string request_id
    }
    ImportJob {
        uuid id PK
        datetime created_at
        datetime updated_at
        uuid organization FK
        uuid uploaded_by FK
        string file_name
        string file_sha256
        string status
        int total_rows
        int success_count
        int failed_count
        json errors
        string file_error
        json pending_rows
        uuid retry_of FK
        datetime started_at
        datetime finished_at
    }
    ImportJob |o--o{ ImportJob : "retry_of"
    Organization |o--o{ AuditLog : "organization"
    Organization ||--o{ ImportJob : "organization"
    User ||--o{ ImportJob : "uploaded_by"
```
